title: openchoreo-control-plane
description: Values of the openchoreo-control-plane wrapper (mgmt). Upstream subchart keys under openchoreo-control-plane are not constrained here; cross-field invariants (hostnames, gateway port, GitHub App wiring) live in templates/validate.yaml.

controlPlane.description: Public endpoints of the control plane.

host.description: Base host: Backstage at <host>, API at api.<host>, Thunder at thunder.<host>.

clusterGatewayURL.description: wss:// URL workload-cluster agents dial (TLS passthrough on gateway.httpsPort).

httpPort.description: Host port of the observability gateway.

store.description: ClusterSecretStore (addon secret-stores) the ExternalSecret reads from.

remoteKey.description: Store key holding the Backstage secrets.

githubApp.description: GitHub App credentials for repository creation (docs/project-templates.md).

enabled.description: Render the ExternalSecret (needs the subchart's GitHub integration, checked in validate.yaml).

store.description: ClusterSecretStore (addon secret-stores) the ExternalSecret reads from.

remoteKey.description: Store key of the platform GitHub App.

secretName.description: Secret Backstage reads GITHUB_APP_ID / GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY from.

costViews.description: Console cost views (Cost Insights page and card, Cost Analysis tab), templates/backstage-cost-views.yaml.

enabled.description: Cluster label addons.platform.koorikla.io/finops-opencost (a string from the ApplicationSet).

extensions.description: Backstage extension IDs switched off while enabled is false.

appExtensions.description: The openchoreo-ui image's app.extensions, repeated because Backstage replaces arrays.

gatewayCA.description: Publish the cluster-gateway CA (public part) to fleet for ClusterResourceSets.

store.description: ClusterSecretStore (addon secret-stores) the ExternalSecret reads from.

namespace.description: Namespace that receives the CA copy.

sourceSecret.description: cert-manager CA Secret of the chart.

openchoreo-control-plane.description: Upstream openchoreo-control-plane subchart values (not constrained here).
